Drum.input: original decoded44.1kHz stereo full mix; PI Drum-exposed candidates only
Drum.anchor: unchanged frozen F_MIX timestamp; no external timestamp input
Drum.representation: per-channel mean squared original PCM in absolute44-sample nonoverlapping bins; no filters or modified audio
Drum.rule: first below-to-above threshold crossing sustained3bins in each channel; p95>=16baseline in both channels; stereo crossings within3ms; return later crossing block start
Drum.tie_break: earliest valid chronological crossing; later of two channel crossings
Drum.abstention: nonpositive baseline, insufficient dynamic rise, missing sustained crossing or stereo disagreement>3ms
Drum.operational_semantics: beginning of sustained sharp broadband energy emergence in source-exposed context; not largest sample/flux or exact physical attack
Drum.uncertainty: bin spacing is numerical resolution only. Do not assign +/-1ms. Compare with preserved8ms review intervals; report empirical interval misses/midpoint residuals and reference widths; no universal uncertainty bound.
Drum.failure: cannot generalize to gradual/overlapping attacks; source exposure is required; one outside-reference output blocks ESTABLISHED, partial coverage limits PROMISING
Drum.validation: remaining8 PI Drum-exposed controls in two separate later passages; no retuning
